GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok drifted back to last 6l off, swung Wide turn, Straightened Up well off all clear, ran on well down the outside # ran on from last
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When questioned re settling further back in the field, rdr std his instructions were to settle just behind the leaders with cover if possible. He said after beginning well, he elected to seek cover, however was obliged to restrain the gelding to the rear of the field to avoid being caught three wide in the early stages. He added the gelding obtained clear running at the entrance to the straight and finished the race off satisfactorily.
